headline: Exact third canonical radial jet sensitivities of full real six-pair temporal operator are principal parts of differentiated primary Hg and reduced secondary Cred; complete positive-K shift two-jet prolongation.

notation.raw_temporal: Cdot_red=A_N N + B_N Nprime + A_M M + B_M Mprime on Fz=Hg=0; Step58 proved Nsecond=Msecond=0 exactly on that primary shell
notation.third_jet: qrrr=third radial derivative of one of all 12 canonical fields; first impose Fz=0 via original pLg_prime relation

exact_constraint_derivative_principal_re.Hg_second_jet: d Hg /d Sg_rr = 2 Mg2 Sg/Lg; all other second radial canonical jet coefficients vanish
exact_constraint_derivative_principal_re.Cred_second_jet: d Cred/d pLg_rr=(1-z²)/Lf, d Cred/d Sg_rr=-pSg(1-z²)/(Lg Lf), d Cred/d theta_g_rr=-pg(1-z²)/(Lg Lf)
exact_constraint_derivative_principal_re.proof_method: Differentiate exact Step58 full six-pair lapse coefficients against all 12 independent third field jet symbols AFTER imposing Fz=0, identify only 1+3 nonzero derivatives, match EXACT algebraic formulas from Step45 Hg second jets and Step57 Cred second jets. Symbolic ZERO residuals verified with SymPy.
exact_constraint_derivative_principal_re.IMPORTANT: These are equalities of highest-JET PRINCIPAL PARTS only. Vanishing Hg'=Cred'=0 along an exactly constrained radial solution does NOT by itself establish full equality of B_N or A_M to those derivative constraints, nor determine the lower-order remainders. Those remain Step60.

exact_positive_K_shift_second_prolongati.zsecond: (K² Dsecond+K Kprime Dprime-D Kprime²-D K Ksecond)/R³ -3*(K² Dprime-D K Kprime)*(D Dprime+K Kprime)/R⁵
exact_positive_K_shift_second_prolongati.stationarity: Fz and its first and second radial total derivatives vanish identically on positive-K root, without freezing zprime or zsecond
exact_positive_K_shift_second_prolongati.normalized_center: Dg=r³ d(s), K=r² k(s), s=r², z=r*w(s), w=d/sqrt(k²+s*d²), zprime=w+2s w_s, zsecond=r*(6w_s+4s w_ss); valid for k>0 and d,k smooth C² in s
exact_positive_K_shift_second_prolongati.center_limit: zsecond=O(r) if d,k twice smooth in s with k>0; conditional smooth radial chart, not whole 4D evolution theorem
